description: This is a Java source file for an Android application activity called 'FingerPaint'. It implements a simple finger painting (sketching) interface with options to change color, apply emboss and blur effects, and clear the canvas. The class extends 'GraphicsActivity' and contains an inner 'View' subclass that handles touch inputs to draw on a bitmap.

classes.name: FingerPaint
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the finger painting interface, menu options, and effect toggles.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, responsible for handling drawing and touch events for finger painting.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the paint and effects.

methods.name: colorChanged
methods.description: Callback when a new color is selected from the color picker dialog.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu for selecting color, effects, and clearing the canvas.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections to change paint effects or color.
